title_candidates: Meta opens Muse Spark 1.1 to developers
summary: Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 improves coding and longer agent tasks, powers Thinking mode in Meta AI, and is now available through a paid developer API.

primary_source.title: Introducing Muse Spark 1.1
primary_source.author: Meta AI
key_facts: Muse Spark 1.1 improves coding and longer agent-style tasks.
The model powers Thinking mode in the Meta AI app and website.
Meta opened developer access through its new Model API.
Muse Spark 1.1 is proprietary rather than an open-weight release.

supporting_sources.title: Meta updates its Spark model, releases developer version

prerequisites: Access to meta.ai in your region

steps.instruction: Open Meta AI and sign in.
Look for Thinking mode in the model or response controls.
Give it a bounded planning task with a budget and dates.
Ask it to separate current web facts from assumptions.
Verify two factual details against the linked sources.
